summary: Preserved candidate PR 3274's valid documentation correction and all-docs guard, reproduced review PR 3304's global-uv-option bypass, and corrected the guard to recognize valid uv global options before `pip install`. This fixes the repository mitigation, not uv 0.11.16 itself.

tests.command: node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs (exact candidate plus temporary `uv --no-cache pip install sglang` fixture)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the exact candidate incorrectly accepted the unsafe valid command.
uv 0.11.16 accepts a global option before the pip subcommand.
Plain old-uv resolution selected sglang==0.5.9 and torch==2.9.1.
The fixed resolver selected sglang==0.5.17 and flash-attn-4==4.0.0b19.
The documented mitigation selected sglang==0.5.17 and flash-attn-4==4.0.0b19.

tests.command: node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs (corrected checker plus three unsafe global-option forms and two negative boundaries)
tests.what_was_measured: Passing-after regression: exactly the three unsafe global-option commands were rejected.
The corrected clean documentation tree passes all checker self-tests and repository checks.
The consolidated change has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: Package resolution and the static documentation checker do not execute GPU code.

remaining_limitations: A manually entered plain `uv pip install sglang` still silently selects sglang==0.5.9 under uv 0.11.16; a repository documentation change cannot alter an installed resolver.
The Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 TP=2 semantic symptom was not reproduced because its weights and required two-GPU topology were unavailable; one assigned GPU cannot qualify it.
No source/native implementation changed. The prepared measured source path was /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/layers/layernorm.py and repository-environment.json supplied no native library.
